current_date: 2024-05-24 (cover title 'Effective from Friday 24th May 2024'; running headers still read 'with effect from 6th February 2023')
current_evidence: The council's 'Guidance and advice notes' planning page still links this same PDF (labelled 'valid from 6th February 2023') as the validation requirements, and searches found no newer list; the 2022 KDN papers relate to the 2023 version.

issues.detail: List date is recorded as 2024-05-01, but the source text Grokbot itself cites says 'Effective from Friday 24th May 2024', so the date should be 2024-05-24. The document is also internally inconsistent, and the workbook does not note this: every page header and footer says 'with effect from 6th February 2023', and the council's guidance page labels the link 'valid from 6th February 2023'.
issues.evidence: PDF title: 'Effective from Friday 24th May 2024'; page headers: 'Kirklees Planning Validation Requirements (with effect from 6th February 2023)'.

issues.detail: These local list items have no app_type row: Affordable Housing Provision (more than 10 dwellings, or smaller masterplanned sites); Climate Change Statement (all applications including householder, proportionate to scale); Community Facilities statement (loss of land or premises in community use; it appears only inside the Householder coal row text); Drainage Strategy (Surface Water) (all majors, 5+ dwellings, commercial schemes of 500m2 or more, and non-householder applications in flood zone 2/3, a 1-in-100 surface water flood area, or with a watercourse or culvert); Land Contamination Assessment (Phase 1 for sensitive end uses, past industrial use, or landfill within 250m); Landfill Statement; Main Town Centre Uses Sequential Test (town centre uses outside defined centres, offices excluded); Planning Statement and Summary (all majors, with a summary where documents exceed 100 pages); Priority Employment Areas Statement (change of use of employment sites in PEAs); Schedule of Residential Accommodation (all new residential, including conversions); Site Waste Management Plan (non-householder demolition or excavation, major residential and commercial, flats, bars and takeaways); Water Bodies Assessment (water bodies of 500-25,000m3, mill ponds, private water supply); Water Quality / Water Framework Directive Assessment (works that modify or affect a water body); Wind Microclimate Assessment (where scale could affect wind conditions outside the building).
issues.evidence: Table 4 local list entries and pp.52+ (Water Bodies, WFD, Wind Microclimate).

issues.detail: The Coal Mining Risk Assessment and Drainage details are both placed under Householder, but the source excludes householders from both. The Coal Mining Risk Assessment applies to 'All non-householder applications within the Development High Risk Areas', and Drainage Details apply to schemes not needing a Drainage Strategy 'excluding householder applications' (apart from hard surfacing of front gardens).
issues.evidence: Grokbot's own trigger excerpts: 'All non-householder applications within the Development High Risk Areas' and '(excluding householder applications)'.

issues.detail: Fire Statement and Highways/access details are placed under Listed building consent and Change of use - prior approval. Grokbot read a merged column of exclusions ('Listed Building Consent applications ... Excluded: Applications for engineering/mining/waste/change of use') as inclusions. The source does not require a Fire Statement or access details for LBC or prior approval applications.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt 'Indicative Access Details Fire Statement WHAT INFORMATION IS REQUIRED Listed Building Consent applications ... Excluded: ... change of use'.

issues.detail: 'Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms' is attached to Prior approval, s73, Discharge of conditions, Non-material amendment and Permission in principle. The trigger excerpt is only the list of application types from Table 5 ('Other application types'), so no S106 requirement applies to these types. Table 5's actual specific requirements are not captured, for example the s73 rule that the council will not accept a variation where the red line changes or the change is not minor, the hedgerow removal notice, the demolition notification, and PiP/TDC.

Ventilation/Extraction details and the Tree survey are placed under Works to trees, and Lighting Assessment is placed under Minerals & waste (county), because PDF table columns were merged. Ventilation is required for Use Class E(b) food uses, pubs, drinking establishments and other uses needing extraction. Lighting is required for exterior lighting likely to affect amenity, dark landscapes or nature, and for sports pitches, car parks, major new buildings and illuminated adverts. Kirklees is a unitary authority and the list has no county-matter category.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpts 'Tree (Arboricultural) Survey Ventilation and/or Extraction Details WHEN IT IS REQUIRED ...' and 'Landfill Statement Lighting Assessment WHEN IT IS REQUIRED linkages.'

issues.detail: Many Full planning trigger excerpts are garbled or come from a neighbouring item. Crime Prevention reads 'Authority, utilities suppliers, sewerage'; the real trigger is all majors, external cash machines, hotels, schools, health and community buildings over 150m2, late-night uses, car parks over 50 spaces and critical infrastructure. Statement of Community Involvement uses the wind-turbine text; the real trigger is majors where pre-application community consultation took place. Open space uses noise text; the real trigger is development of open space or playing fields, loss of Urban Green Space, or 11+ dwellings. Noise reads 'should be carried out by a suitably competent person', which is not a trigger. Daylight/Sunlight is only a guidance title; the real trigger is residential schemes likely to get low daylight or cause significant overshadowing. Travel Plan is cut off at 'Required for the following: i.'; the real trigger is 50+ dwellings or more than 0.5 ha, or non-residential over 1,000m2 or 1 ha. Air Quality runs into the agricultural building text and drops the triggers for 20m from 10,000 AADT roads, car parks of 100+/50+ spaces, biomass boilers and 200+ HGV movements a day.
issues.evidence: Table 4 'WHEN IT IS REQUIRED' column for each item.

issues.detail: Several app_type rows are not requirements in the source. 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' is affordable housing text. 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)' is Climate Change Statement content (renewable energy, waste minimisation). 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is the introduction's list of aims. 'Photographs / Photomontages' is a note about materials samples. 'Waste / Refuse storage' quotes elevation drawing guidance. 'Ground investigation' is a bullet within Drainage Strategy content. 'Housing mix' is a list of guidance documents.

Most tab_items are process or boilerplate text: USB and hard-copy submission (4.3/4.4), the 7-day missing-information notice (3.1), emailing planning.portal@kirklees.gov.uk, the NPPF reference and Development Plan description (5.1), GDPR/data protection paragraphs 6.2-6.3, and guidance reference lists (CIEEM guidelines, bat survey URL, contaminated land guidance URL fragments).
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms / checklists'.

issues.detail: Some triggers are truncated and drop thresholds. Health Impact Assessment shows only '(i) 50 dwellings and above', omitting majors over 1,000m2 in wards with poor health indicators or among the five most deprived wards. The Main Town Centre Uses impact trigger is cut off before the 200m2-within-800m-of-a-Local-Centre threshold. The Householder Heritage trigger shows only 'Applications affecting a scheduled monument', although the requirement covers conservation areas, listed buildings, registered parks and non-designated assets. The Agricultural row merges two separate items: the rural workers' dwelling statement and the agricultural/forestry building justification.
issues.evidence: Table 4 HIA, Main Town Centre Uses Impact Assessment and Heritage Statement entries.

issues.detail: The general rows carry the usual 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' tag, and Outline and Reserved matters are shown as '(none)', although Table 4 applies to all applications, outline included. Requirements that the source ties to LBC are also not placed there: the Heritage Statement for LBC, and the Structural Survey for 'listed building consent ... involving structural alterations'.
issues.evidence: Table 4 Structural Survey: 'listed building consent and relevant Conservation Area demolition involving structural alterations'.

summary: Grokbot's link is still the current Kirklees list, effective 24 May 2024 although the page headers say 6 Feb 2023; the workbook records the date as 2024-05-01. The extraction has serious problems: about 14 local items have no row, and merged PDF columns put Coal Mining and Drainage under Householder, Fire Statement under LBC and prior approval, S106 heads of terms under s73/NMA/PiP, and Ventilation under tree works.
